blocks.text: The Senate resumes the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday, September 28, as senators continue deliberations in the historic trial. Follow CDN Digital’s live coverage below for the latest developments, key exchanges, and updates from the Senate as the proceedings unfold. Impeachment Trial Day 30: Baste Duterte may be called as witness Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte may take the witness stand on the 30th day of his sister Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial before the House of Representatives.
